1.title: A Shrinking Work Force Is Changing the C.D.C.
1.summary: The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention has lost close to 30 percent of its staff in the past year, with big turnover in top leadership and entire teams effectively shut down. Our health reporter Apoorva Mandavilli explains how these changes have affected the work of the department.

2.title: VoteVets Spends Millions to Elect Democrats, Shaping Midterms
2.summary: The organization, founded in 2006 to back Democratic veterans opposing the Iraq war, is pouring huge sums into this year’s elections amid intense voter antipathy for another conflict in the Middle East.

3.title: In Coastal Towns, the Nor’easter Upended Wedding Plans
3.summary: Across the northeast, couples were forced to postpone, relocate or cancel weddings they planned to hold outdoors this weekend.

4.title: Six Dead After Explosion in Athens Tourist District
4.summary: Officials said a gas leak might have caused the blast, which destroyed a building and rattled a part of the Greek capital that draws many visitors.

5.title: A Tetris-Like Maze Blocks Protests in Pakistan’s Capital
5.summary: Pakistani authorities have barricaded Islamabad with more than 1,500 shipping containers to stop opposition protesters, choking off access to the capital.

6.title: At Summit, Xi Sought to Tilt Trump’s Stance on America’s Place in Asia
6.summary: In his talks with President Trump, the Chinese leader used praise, warnings and wartime history to challenge American support for Taiwan and Japan.
